properties.NAME: ILLINOIS (Va., ext)
properties.CHANGE: ILLINOIS County (Va., extinct) created by Virginia to encompass all territory N and W of the Ohio Riv. & east of the Mississippi Riv. claimed by Virginia on the basis of its 1609 charter; ILLINOIS County included all of present Indiana.

properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Virginia ceded to the United States its charter claims to territory "northwestward of the river Ohio." All of present Indiana became unorganized federal territory.

properties.NAME: Northwest Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The U.S. created the Territory of the United States Northwest of the River Ohio (Northwest Territory) from unorganized federal territory. Map depicts non-county area of the Northwest Territory in present Indiana.

properties.NAME: KNOX
properties.CHANGE: KNOX created by Northwest Territory from non-county area; included all of present Indiana, plus parts of present Illinois, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin.

properties.CHANGE: WAYNE (N.W. Terr., extinct) created by Northwest Territory from HAMILTON (Ohio), KNOX, and non-county area ; included parts of present Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin.
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 2:567-568, and 3:447; Pence and Armstrong, 216)
